query:
SELECT 
  empresaSlug,
  COUNT(DISTINCT data) as total_dias,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN (CAST(cat1 AS DECIMAL)+CAST(cat2 AS DECIMAL)+CAST(cat3 AS DECIMAL)+CAST(cat4 AS DECIMAL)+CAST(cat5 AS DECIMAL)+CAST(cat6 AS DECIMAL)+CAST(cat7 AS DECIMAL)+CAST(cat8 AS DECIMAL)) > 0 THEN data END) as dias_com_fat_real,
  MIN(data) as primeiro_dia,
  MAX(data) as ultimo_dia
FROM faturamentos
WHERE data LIKE '2026-05-%'
GROUP BY empresaSlug
ORDER BY empresaSlug;
